decision.explanation: The question 'When was the Cardinal of Guise born?' refers to a title held by three distinct individuals in the House of Guise, as evidenced by the source documents. D1S1 and D2S1 describe Louis I, Cardinal of Guise, born 21 October 1527. D4S1, D5S1, and D6S1 describe Louis II, Cardinal of Guise, born 6 July 1555. D3S1 describes Louis III, Cardinal of Guise, born 22 January 1575. The prompt instructions state that distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers may coexist and that competing assertions about one referent are not automatically distinct valid answers, but here the assertions refer to *different* entities (Louis I, II, and III) who share the same title. Therefore, all three birth dates are valid answers corresponding to the specific individual named in each source segment.
